title: Research 2026-11-07
body:
Studied: the engine's 681 live orders since Nov 4 (479 bids, 202 bets) and their settled results.
Evidence: 330 settled, +$27.40 on $268 staked (bids +10.7%, bets +9.2%). The quoted edge averaged only 3-4%, so most of that is luck; the true rate is probably nearer 3-4%. Live-game lane: 2 orders (1 win, 1 loss, net -$0.66); the lane is switched off.
Changed today: small and soft books can no longer feed the fair (about 50 books); the matcher no longer treats Virginia as West Virginia.
Next: docs review of ParlayAPI, Novig and PropLine, then the player and prop matching audit.
Engine: 758 bids resting ($342); the latest bet pass placed 0 (8 markets already open, thin-book fairs held back).
